flows.name: T04-创建分组-原句闭环-接受-刷新-撤销

steps.eval: (() => { const sels = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#chat-scroll .question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled); for (const sel of sels.reverse()) { const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) continue; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; } return false; })()

steps.text: 把总耗电概览和能耗趋势分析放进能耗概览分组

steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan]').innerText; return t.includes('能耗概览'); })()
(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan]').innerText; return t.includes('总耗电概览') && t.includes('能耗趋势分析'); })()
(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan]').innerText; return !t.includes('设备耗电排名'); })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-pending-plan] select'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; sel.value = opt.value; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="group"]'); return !!el && el.getAttribute('data-region-id') !== null; })()

(() => { const g = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="group"]'); if (!g) return false; const ids = Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('[data-region-id]')).map(el => el.dataset.regionId); return ids.includes('region_total_energy') && ids.includes('region_hourly_trend'); })()

(() => { const g = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="group"]'); if (!g) return false; const ids = Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('[data-region-id]')).map(el => el.dataset.regionId); return !ids.includes('region_device_ranking'); })()

(() => { const g = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="group"]'); if (!g) return false; const ids = Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('[data-region-id]')).map(el => el.dataset.regionId); return ids.includes('region_total_energy') && ids.includes('region_hourly_trend') && !ids.includes('region_device_ranking'); })()

(() => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-wp-history]'); if (!sel) return false; const opt = Array.from(sel.options).find(o => o.value === 'undo'); if (!opt || opt.disabled) return false; sel.value = 'undo'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
